elena_voss.name: Elena Voss
elena_voss.personality: Blunt and unhurried — cares more about the manifest than the view.

start.text: Freighter One here. Hope you're not looking to relieve me of my cargo.

hello.text: Ha! Fair enough. Fly safe out there.

cargo.text: Nothing you'd want - spare parts and paperwork, mostly. Now if you had something worth trading...

kade_marsh.name: Kade Marsh
kade_marsh.personality: By-the-book and watchful, quick to flag anything out of place.

one_way_hail.message: Unregistered vessel, this is Patrol One. Identify yourself or alter course.

start.text: Patrol One to unregistered vessel - state your business in this system.

start_returning.text: Back again? Still reading clean on my scope. Carry on.

passing.text: Copy that. Keep your transponder active and we won't have a problem.

routes.text: We hold the line between the station and the moon. Anything past that, you're on your own.

priya_nandan.name: Priya Nandan
priya_nandan.personality: Chatty and opportunistic, always working an angle.

oskar_lindqvist.name: Oskar Lindqvist
oskar_lindqvist.personality: Gruff and practical, more comfortable with machinery than people.

mira_solis.name: Mira Solis
mira_solis.personality: Restless and curious, always chasing the next horizon.

dax_okafor.name: Dax Okafor
dax_okafor.personality: Fast-talking and faster-flying, thrives under a deadline.

rex_calder.name: Rex Calder
rex_calder.personality: Gruff and territorial, treats every claim boundary like it's already been shot at once.

juno_vale.name: Juno Vale
juno_vale.personality: Never stays anywhere long, already thinking about whatever's over the next horizon.
